items.t: HSBC Holdings (LSE:HSBA) Appoints Neha Ghai To Global Private Bank Role
items.sum: HSBC Holdings (LSE:HSBA) has appointed Neha Ghai as director, global private bank, within its private banking arm. Ghai brings international wealth experience from markets such as India, Singapore, and China to the global private banking team.
